$comment: The fixture consumer's scene manifest — its own curation, in its own layout.
Paths are `app/...`, not `packages/frontend/src/...`, and that is the point: the
plugin reads this through `options.scenes` and resolves every path against
`options.root`, so a project that keeps its routes anywhere at all works.
NOT `deferred`, unlike every wafflebase scene: a deferred entry is dropped from the
generated module entirely, so it would prove nothing about path resolution. Live, the
module names the scene and its `app/` file, which is exactly the claim.
AS OF 11b THIS SCENE MOUNTS. Through 11a nothing did — the gate drove the JSON API,
the generated loader was never called, and the project needed no React. The frame now
renders `app/pages/dashboard.tsx` through the consumer's own `plugin-react`, with none
of wafflebase's providers or fixtures involved, which is what makes this fixture the
proof that the frame works on a project that is not wafflebase.
